facts.text: S-Band Antenna was deployed at Ocean of Storms during Apollo 12 in 1969.
An erectable S-band antenna deployed near the LM to provide a high-gain communication link with Mission Control. Replaced the small LM antenna for better TV and data transmission.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Provided the high-gain communication link that enabled high-quality colour television broadcasts and science data transmission from the lunar surface.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Ocean of Storms.
Remains near the Intrepid landing site; its erectable parabolic design was carried on all subsequent Apollo missions for reliable deep-space communication.
